items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Ukraine with 137 UAVs overnight, including 49 jet-powered Shaheds. Ukraine's air defence destroyed or jammed 114 drones, while hits were recorded at 17 locations.

items.title: PM Jetten: Netherlands to help Ukraine with F-16 maintenance, spare parts and ammunition
items.teaser: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten, following a phone call with President Volodymyr Zelensky, stated that the Netherlands will assist Ukraine with maintenance, spare parts, and ammunition for F-16 fighter jets.

items.title: Khortiani: Campaign of hatred against Ukraine in Hungary fails
items.teaser: A large-scale anti-Ukrainian information campaign in Hungary, in which Russia invested enormous sums, has collapsed, and the election results showed that inciting hatred toward Ukraine did not yield the expected outcome.

items.title: Russian attacks injure two people in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, industrial facility catches fire
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked three districts of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast nearly 20 times with drones, injuring two people in the Nikopol district and causing fires at an industrial facility.

items.title: Russian drone strikes Zaporizhzhia bridge in overnight attack
items.teaser: The bridge has been closed, and traffic rerouted, according to the Zaporizhzhia City Council. The strike follows multiple attacks on bridges in central Kyiv in the past week.

items.title: Russian forces attack infrastructure facilities in Odesa overnight – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked infrastructure in Odesa overnight, damaging a building belonging to a private company. No one was killed or injured and no residential buildings were damaged.

items.title: Zelensky appoints Klymenko as chair of Council of Experts on Energy Security
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky has appointed Ihor Klymenko, Secretary of the National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine, as chairman of the Council of Experts on Energy Security—an advisory body to the NSDC.

items.title: Russia loses 1,540 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,540 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Zelensky thanks Territorial Defense Forces soldiers for defending Ukraine since first days of full-scale war
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky thanked the territorial defense forces, who have stood up to defend Ukraine since the very first days of the full-scale Russian invasion, and honored them with state awards.

items.title: Russia strikes bridge in Zaporizhzhia: five injured – photo
items.teaser: A Russian strike hit a bridge over the Dnipro River in Zaporizhzhia, injuring five people and forcing authorities to temporarily close the bridge to traffic.

items.title: South Korea shipped fuel to Russia via sanctioned vessels, media reports
items.teaser: Potentially undermining sanctions, over 176,000 tonnes of fuel, mostly diesel, from South Korean ports were loaded onto sanctioned Russian tankers, based on analysis of port records and ship-tracking data.

items.title: Drone debris falls on roof of educational institution in Kyiv, causing fire – photo
items.teaser: Drone debris caused a fire on the roof of an educational institution in Kyiv's Obolonskyi district on the morning of 6 October. Firefighters extinguished the blaze and no one was injured.

items.title: Operation “Tigers”: Odesa National Guard troops use drones to evacuate cats from Oleshky
items.teaser: Service members of the “Bolharychi” Special Forces Company (RUBpAK) of the Special Forces Battalion (BBS) of the 11th M. Hrushevsky Brigade of the National Guard of Ukraine carried out a unique operation to rescue cats from Oleshky.

items.title: Im Kampf gegen die Huthis - Türkei und Pakistan schicken Truppen
items.teaser: Inmitten des eskalierenden Konflikts mit der Huthi-Terror-Miliz im Jemen ist Saudi-Arabiens Hauptstadt von lauten Explosionen erschü...

items.title: Russian attack destroys pharmaceutical plant in Sumy, employee killed
items.teaser: A pharmaceutical plant operated by KUSUM was destroyed in the city of Sumy as a result of a Russian attack on October 4, and one of the company’s employees was killed.

items.title: FT: Hungary may lift veto on next stage of Ukraine's EU accession talks this week
items.teaser: Hungary is expected to lift its veto this week on the technical stage of Ukraine's EU accession process.

items.title: Ukrainian drones reportedly attack Moscow Oblast in mass attack near Russia's capital
items.teaser: Ukrainian drones targeted Moscow Oblast in a mass attack as air defenses in the region are engaged, monitoring channels reported overnight on Oct. 6.

items.title: Moscow comes under large-scale drone attack – photos, videos
items.teaser: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin says 650 drones were heading towards Moscow and Moscow Oblast between the evening of 5 October and early 6 October, with 105 reportedly destroyed while approaching the capital.

items.title: Ukraine's EU Accession: Kos hopes two more clusters to open next week
items.teaser: The European Union is closely monitoring the work of Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada, particularly the adoption of expected amendments to legislation concerning national minorities.

items.title: Wadephul: Moskau hat "weitergehende Pläne" als Ukraine
items.teaser: Bundesaußenminister Johann Wadephul warnt, dass Russland auch Ansprüche auf das Baltikum formulieren könnte. Als Alliierter wäre Deutschland mit betroffen.

items.title: Trump says US will 'help' Russia deal with plague
items.teaser: "I hate to see them having it; it's a rough disease," U.S. President Donald Trump said. "We'll help anybody that has that kind of problem, were willing to help."

items.title: Ukrainians in Málaga hold rally in support of occupied Oleshky
items.teaser: The Ukrainian community in the Spanish city of Málaga held a rally in support of the residents of the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky, calling on the international community to draw attention to the humanitarian situation there.

items.title: Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, October 5, 2026
items.teaser: Toplines A Russian drone struck a Ukrainian-Moldovan border crossing on the morning of October 5, injuring a Moldovan citizen — the first confirmed Moldovan injury due…

items.title: Trump verdächtigt Teheran: Flydubai-Copilot plante offenbar Anschlag auf Tel Aviv
items.teaser: Nach der Axt-Attacke im Cockpit während eines Flugs nach Tel Aviv verdichten sich die Hinweise auf einen geplanten Terroranschlag. Der Copilot habe den Ben-Gurion-Flughafen anvisiert, berichten US-Medien. Trump macht Teheran für den Vorfall verantwortlich.

items.title: Ukraine and Germany to deepen partnership to support war-affected businesses
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Minister of Economy and Environment Oleksandr Kravchenko met on October 4 with Germany’s Federal Minister for Economic Affairs and Energy Katherina Reiche during her visit to Kyiv.

items.title: Russian attacks on Kharkiv Oblast kill one and injure 20 people – photos
items.teaser: One person was killed and 20 injured in Russian attacks across Kharkiv Oblast on 5 October, including drone strikes and an attack with Tornado-S multiple-launch rocket systems.

items.title: US not removing diplomats from Kyiv amid Russian threats, Rubio says
items.teaser: "(I)f a threat arises that we feel needs to be addressed by a change in posture, we'll do so. We haven't done that up to this point," U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said.

items.title: Russian strike on Kharkiv death toll rises to six, with 59 people injured
items.teaser: In Kharkiv, body parts of a sixth victim of the Russian strike were found; 59 people were injured.

items.title: BND, MAD und Verfassungsschutz - Grünen-Politiker von Notz bekräftigt Einschätzung der Geheimdienste zu Russland
items.teaser: Der Grünen-Bundestagsabgeordnete von Notz hat die Einschätzung der Geheimdienste zur Bedrohung durch Russland bekräftigt. Man müsse die Ensthaftigkeit der Lage erkennen, sagte er dem Deutschlandfunk. Die Erkenntnisse müssten aber auch bei der Bevölkerung ankommen.

items.title: Macron and Zelensky discuss assistance to Ukraine in intercepting Russian drones
items.teaser: French President Emmanuel Macron discussed with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky what assistance Paris could provide to intercept Russian drones.

items.title: Russia attacks Kyiv as drone debris falls into residential area, sets cars ablaze
items.teaser: Russia again targeted Kyiv late on Oct. 5, with drone debris falling into a residential area in Kyiv's Pecherskyi district after air defenses shot it down, reporters on the ground said.

items.title: „Deppen“: Mutmaßliche Iran-Terroristen verrieten sich selbst
items.teaser: Im ländlichen England konnte wohl ein Angriff auf einen von den USA genutzten Luftwaffenstützpunkt verhindert werden. Recherchen zeigen, dass sich die Männer wohl ziemlich amateurhaft verhielten.

items.title: Drone debris falls near residential building in Kyiv's Pechersk district, cars catch fire
items.teaser: In Kyiv’s Pechersk district, debris fell onto an open area of a residential building, causing parked cars to catch fire.

items.title: Russians strike apartment building in Zaporizhzhia: people injured – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces struck an apartment building in Zaporizhzhia on the evening of 5 October, injuring two people.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine prepares new contracts for air defense systems and missiles as infrastructure protection remains key challenge
items.teaser: Ukraine is preparing new contracts for air defense systems and missiles for its air defense forces and is calling on its partners to provide more anti-ballistic defense capabilities to protect its infrastructure.

items.title: From making interceptors to guarding sky: Ukrainian drone maker gets its own private air defense unit and will pay for it from weapon sales
items.teaser: The company says its Night Hornets unit has downed more than 50 Shaheds.

items.title: Russian drone strikes high-rise building in Zaporizhzhia, causing casualties and apartment fires
items.teaser: Two people are reportedly injured after a drone struck a residential apartment building in Zaporizhzhia. People are also trapped on one of the building’s floors.

items.title: Operation „Tiger“: ukrainische Soldaten retten Katzen aus besetztem Oleschky mithilfe von Drohnen
items.teaser: Soldaten der Kompanie RUBpAK „Bolgarytschi“ des Bataillons für unbemannte Systeme der 11. Mychajlo- Hruschewskyj - Brigade der Nationalgarde der Ukraine haben eine einmalige Operation zur Rettung von Katzen aus der russisch besetzten Stadt Oleschky im Gebiet Cherson durchgeführt.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine expects partners to meet arms delivery deadlines
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky held a meeting with the team from the Ministry of Defense of Ukraine and the diplomatic team from the Office of the President regarding the schedule for arms deliveries from partners, and also set new tasks for long-range operations.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Kharkiv devastated by Russian glide bombs, children among victims
items.teaser: Key developments on Oct. 5: Children among dozens injured as Russian glide bombs hit Kharkiv, 5 dead New automatic gun turrets successfully down first Russian jet-powered drones, Air Force says Russian drones strike cargo ship in Black Sea, kill captain, Zelensky says Ukrainian pilots to soon start training on French

items.title: Russian drone debris falls on cars in Kyiv: fire breaks out
items.teaser: Russian drone debris fell on the grounds of a residential building in Kyiv on the evening of 5 October.

items.title: Dutzende Wohnhäuser beschädigt: in Charkiw steigt die Zahl der Todesopfer auf fünf, 53 Menschen verletzt
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Todesopfer nach einem russischen Angriff auf Charkiw ist auf fünf gestiegen, die der Verletzten - auf 53, teilt der Bürgermeister Ihor Terechow auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Zelensky discusses strengthening air defenses and protection against Shahed drones with Dutch PM
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed with Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten the strengthening of Ukraine’s air defense, particularly protection against Russian “Shahed” drones, as well as the prospects for trilateral talks between Ukraine, the U.S., and Russia.

items.title: What if Russia uses nuclear weapons? Can we say Ukraine brought peace to world? Norwegian professor who nominated Zelenskyy and Ukrainians for 2026 Nobel Peace Prize takes on tough questions
items.teaser: He explains why he thinks US President Donald Trump won't win the Nobel Peace Prize this year, and why Ukraine should.

items.title: Six killed and 59 injured in Russian attack on Kharkiv – photos
items.teaser: The attack has damaged residential buildings, cars, a warehouse and an industrial facility in Kharkiv’s Slobidskyi district; 30 people are still in hospital, including three in an extremely serious condition.

items.title: Lizenz zur Attacke für Spione?: BND-Chef: "Russland stellt uns auf die Probe"
items.teaser: Der BND erwartet weitere Eingriffe Russlands "auch bei uns", sagt Dienst-Chef Jäger. Zur Abwehr brauchen Spione mehr Befugnisse. Doch Kritikern geht das geplante neue Gesetz zu weit.

items.title: Trump yet again blames Ukraine for rising fuel prices
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump attributes higher petrol prices to attacks on Russia’s oil refining facilities, while also blaming refinery closures in Democratic-led US states.

items.title: Civilian rescues two Ukrainian ground robots in Sumy region
items.teaser: In the Sumy region, a civilian rescued two Ukrainian ground troops—one of whom had been injured by a landmine, while the other had arrived to evacuate him—but complications arose during the rescue operation.

items.title: Zelenskyy and Dutch PM discuss strengthening Ukraine's air defence
items.teaser: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten says the Netherlands will help Ukraine with F-16 maintenance, spare parts and ammunition as Kyiv seeks stronger air defences against Russian attacks.

items.title: Putin allows Italy's UniCredit banking group to reorganize, sell Russian subsidiary
items.teaser: UniCredit, one of the few European banks still active in Russia, announced in May that it plans to sell most of its Russian subsidiary — UniCredit Bank Russia — to a private investor from the United Arab Emirates, while retaining control over its payments arm.

items.title: Selenskyj: Frankreich beginnt bald Ausbildung ukrainischer Piloten an Rafale - Kampfjets
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj hat mit seinem französischen Amtskollegen Emmanuel Macron die russische terroristische Eskalation, die Bedarfe der Streitkräfte, neue Waffenlieferungen sowie die Ausbildung ukrainischer Piloten an französischen Rafale - Kampfjets besprochen.

items.title: Mann wollte Soldaten rekrutieren: Uni-Professor plante offenbar Anschläge auf Hunderte arabische Israelis
items.teaser: Ein israelischer Hochschullehrer wird festgenommen, weil er laut Staatsanwaltschaft arabische Israelis und Palästinenser töten wollte. Als Motiv werden "nationalistische Gründe" genannt - offenbar sollten durch die Angriffe Nicht-Juden aus Israel vertrieben werden.

items.title: He fled Maduro's Venezuela. Now he leads Ukraine's South American battalion.
items.teaser: The Bolivar Battalion consists of about 250 soldiers, most of them from Colombia, Chile, and Veneuzela.

items.title: Wie die Chefs der Nachrichtendienste die Sicherheitslage einschätzen
items.teaser: Einschüchterung, Cyberangriffe, Anschlagspläne - Russland führe einen "Schattenkrieg" gegen Deutschland, sagt BND-Chef Jäger. Ein offener Krieg sei das nicht, doch die Grenze verschwimme. Was bedeutet das? Von O. Neuroth.

items.title: Rubio responds to Russia's call for foreign diplomatic missions to leave Kyiv
items.teaser: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says Washington reviews the safety of its diplomatic missions daily and would change its security posture if necessary, but has not done so in Kyiv.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 50 times, killing one and injuring one person
items.teaser: Throughout the day, Russian troops launched nearly 50 drone and artillery attacks on three districts in the Dnipropetrovsk region; one man was killed and another was wounded.

items.title: Russian attack destroys Kusum pharmaceutical plant in Sumy
items.teaser: A Kusum employee was killed when the company’s Sumy facility was destroyed on 4 October. The pharmaceutical firm is assessing the damage and says it will work to maintain uninterrupted medicine supplies.

items.title: Russen zerstören Pharmaunternehmen in Sumy, ein Mitarbeiter getötet
items.teaser: In der Stadt Sumy ist ein Werk des Pharmaunternehmens „KUSUM“ bei einem russischen Angriff am 4. Oktober zerstört worden. Ein Mitarbeiter kam ums Leben.

items.title: Kämpfe im Jemen gehen weiter: Regierungstruppen wollen Huthis an wichtiger Meerenge zurückgedrängt haben
items.teaser: Die jemenitische Regierung gelobt, von den Huthis eroberte Landesteile "aus den Fängen der terroristischen Miliz" zu befreien. Kurz darauf vermelden die Truppen einen Erfolg, der Auswirkungen auf den globalen Handel haben könnte. Die Huthis bleiben jedoch weiter gefährlich.

items.title: Russian women's volleyball team allowed to compete at 2027 World Cup
items.teaser: Russia will compete at the 2027 Women’s Volleyball World Cup in the US and Canada, marking the first time Russia and Ukraine have taken part in the same major event since Russia’s full-scale invasion

items.title: Ukrenergo forecasts no power outages on Tuesday
items.teaser: No restrictions on electricity consumption are planned in Ukraine on Tuesday, October 6.

items.title: Russia burned 628,000 new school textbooks in Kharkiv at the peak of back-to-school season
items.teaser: They sat in Ranok's warehouse, built on the site of a former bread factory, with millions of other books. Firefighters fought the blaze for a week.

items.title: Lithuania delivers 253 tonnes of energy equipment to Ukraine
items.teaser: The shipment includes three power transformers for Khmelnytskyi Oblast and a 200 MVA autotransformer with 76 pieces of auxiliary equipment for Ukrenergo.

items.title: Ukraine wants to aim Starlink at Russian targets—and build a version Elon Musk can’t switch off
items.teaser: The reason, Zelenskyy says: China and others will soon share comparable satellite technology with Moscow.

items.title: Ukrainian pilots to soon start training on French Rafale jets, Zelensky says
items.teaser: France is preparing fresh defense assistance for Ukraine amid relentless Russian aerial attacks, with a new support package expected "soon," Zelensky revealed after his call with French President Emmanuel Macron.

items.title: Zelensky after call with Macron: Ukrainian pilots to begin Rafale training soon
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed Russia's terrorist escalation, Ukraine's defense needs, new defense deliveries, and the training of Ukrainian pilots on French Rafale aircraft with French President Emmanuel Macron.

items.title: Ukraine says Russian drones behind Turkish ship sinking
items.teaser: Romanian authorities did not say what caused the fire, but local media reported that the ship was carrying grain and was hit by a drone.

items.title: Trump's Ukraine-Russia peace gambit begins to unravel. Again
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump's latest push for peace between Ukraine and Russia is facing growing uncertainty, with few in Kyiv believing it can deliver a breakthrough — or even bring the three sides together for talks, the Kyiv Independent can reveal. The latest effort began in early

items.title: Russian strike in Chuhuiv destroys two houses, woman rescued from rubble
items.teaser: In Chuhuiv, Kharkiv region, rescuers freed a woman from the rubble of a house destroyed by a Russian strike.

items.title: Nähe zur extremistischen PKK - Verfassungsschutz nimmt Eralp ins Visier
items.teaser: Berliner Linke steht wegen Judenhass und Clan-Nähe massiv in der Kritik.

items.title: Ukraine's Roboneers and Germany's ARX Robotics agree on strategic partnership
items.teaser: German defence company ARX Robotics and Roboneers, a Ukrainian manufacturer of unmanned ground vehicles, have signed a strategic partnership agreement in the presence of German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

items.title: First ton-scale drone lifeline: Ukraine flies 4 more tons of aid into a starving Russian-occupied town of Oleshky
items.teaser: Ukraine is using repeated, ton-scale drone deliveries to bring food and medicine to civilians in an occupied town where food cannot get in and Russian forces are taking supplies from residents.

items.title: Ukraine demines over 1,300 hectares in September. Now, it has new plan to tackle 132,000 km²
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Ministry demined 1,347 hectares of liberated land in September, a fraction of the territory that makes it the world's most mined country.

items.title: Drei Tote und 39 Verletzte bei russischem Angriff auf Charkiw: Wohnhäuser, Lager und Tankstellen beschädigt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff auf Charkiw sind drei Menschen getötet und 39 weitere verletzt worden, teilt die regionale Staatsanwaltschaft auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Discussion on whether to shoot down Russian drones over Ukraine is ongoing, Polish foreign minister says
items.teaser: Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski says Poland supports the idea in principle but cannot make the decision alone because NATO’s integrated air defence system covers the Alliance’s eastern flank.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukrainian pilots will begin training on Rafale jets soon
items.teaser: Zelenskyy says France is preparing a new defence package for Ukraine, and Ukrainian pilots are set to begin training on the Rafale.

items.title: Russian forces attack gymnasium in Kushuhum, Zaporizhzhia region
items.teaser: A gymnasium in Kushuhum, Zaporizhzhia region, was hit in an airstrike.

items.title: Ukraine-Moldova border crossing point reopens after Russian drone incident
items.teaser: Ukraine's State Border Guard Service has announced that the Palanka-Maiaky-Udobne crossing point on the border with Moldova has reopened following an incident involving a Russian drone.
